title: The Orchard of Bellbird Bay
author: August Joubert
blurb: Jonah Thornbury, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent fifteen years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
